# Инженер Геодези ХХК (Engineering Geodesy LLC)

> Mongolian geodesy, geology, urban planning, land-management and accredited laboratory services company, founded in 1993. Headquartered in Ulaanbaatar, serving public-sector and private-sector clients across Mongolia.

## About

- **Founded:** 1993
- **Headquarters:** Khan-Uul District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia
- **Phone:** +976 7727-8899
- **Email:** post@geo-mongol.com
- **Website:** https://geo-mongol.mn

## Services

- [Геодези геоматикийн групп / Geodesy & Geomatics Group](https://geo-mongol.mn/geodesyGroup): Building geodetic networks, performing all topographic and aerial / ground-based mapping work for domestic and international clients.
- [Хот төлөвлөлт, архитектурын групп / Urban Planning & Architecture Group](https://geo-mongol.mn/architecture): Construction, architecture and urban planning services. 10+ years of operations.
- [Газрын харилцаа, газрын үнэлгээний групп / Land Management & Valuation Group](https://geo-mongol.mn/landRating): Land use planning and land valuation for Mongolia's national zoning plan, including industrial-zone land planning.
- [Геотехник, гидрогеологи, геофизикийн групп / Geotechnics, Hydrogeology & Geophysics Group](https://geo-mongol.mn/geologyGroup): Engineering geology surveys and ground testing for construction sites.
- [Итгэмжлэгдсэн хөрс судлалын лаборатори TL-78 / Accredited Soil-Testing Laboratory TL-78](https://geo-mongol.mn/lab-tl-78): MNS ISO/IEC 17025:2018 accredited soil and water testing — physical/mechanical soil analysis, density quality control, soil chemistry, environmental assessment, agricultural fertility, heavy-metal soil contamination, rock testing, field tests.
- [Итгэмжлэгдсэн геодезийн хэмжилзүйн лаборатори CL-07 / Accredited Geodetic Metrology Laboratory CL-07](https://geo-mongol.mn/lab-cl-07): MNS ISO/IEC 17025:2018 accredited metrology lab. Calibration and verification of geodetic instruments (total stations, theodolites, levels, GNSS receivers, laser scanners, UAV cameras). Partners with Topcon (USA), Kolida & Hi-Target (China), Pentax & Sokkia (Japan).
